scope: Connected original io_uring submitter authority across solo import, observer capture, source handoff, future context changes, completion, cancellation and resource release.

architecture.acceptance: Execution retains the original DirectFds capability. Task-sensitive byte resources bind once from the accepted original OFD and submitter; no numeric FD lookup is repeated on retry.
architecture.observers: Only matching original mm/task capture may bind legacy requests that have no execution lease. Foreign CQ observers cannot donate their signal reader.
architecture.context_changes: Consuming DirectSyscalls setters invalidate the future Execution cache; existing requests retain their immutable original Arc. Explicit signal-reader configuration survives incoming ring snapshots independent of builder order.
architecture.lifetime: Fixed OFDs, vector/fixed-buffer reads and polls retain their original reader through close/reuse and source handoff. Completion/cancellation releases the original request lease; cancellation leaves payload untouched.
architecture.signals: An accepted delayed native-file size failure notifies its original task; later requests use a newly configured task signal sink.

shared_regressions: Solo accepted scalar/vector/registered-buffer signalfd reads and poll retain the original submitting reader.
An unrelated CQ capture cannot fill another task original resource.
A wrong reader cannot wake/consume the original request, and a later submission uses its own reader.
Original numeric FD close/reuse does not change the accepted OFD.
Cancellation leaves the destination sentinel untouched and releases the reader; normal completion releases it too.
A task asleep on an original infinite futex can complete its already accepted async read after a peer sends a real private signal, on 4/12 logical CPUs and one execution slot.
A delayed native-file failure uses the old signal sink while a subsequent request uses the updated sink.

native.baseline: Original native solo signalfd SQE completes with -95; the guest detects that wrong result and exits 255.
native.final: All original read CQ results are 128 and each guest actor verifies signal data. Native 4/12 CPU cases use one cohort, zero returned syscalls and zero services.

validation_notes: The future-context baseline is explicitly after the descriptor-binding correction and before cache invalidation; it is not described as an untouched prior revision.
